en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4669 - Abdullah ibn Ja'far al-Himyari wrote to Abu Muhammad Al-Hasan ibn Ali Al-Askari (as)

asking about a woman who breastfed a man's child.
He asked: "Is it permissible for that man to marry the daughter of this wet nurse or not?"
Imam (as) responded, "It is not permissible for him."
